name: Cartitas draft generator
description: Daily agent writes kid flashcards into draft/{lang}/ and keeps one open PR for review.

prompts.prompt:
Follow .cursor/automation-generate-draft.md exactly.

Each run pick ONE language (en, es, de — rotate) and ONE topic from publish.yaml where generate.enabled is true.

1. Read languages.yaml, publish.yaml, templates/card-style.md, templates/topic-seeds/{topic}.md.
2. Scan cards/{lang}/, queue/{lang}/, draft/{lang}/ for duplicates.
3. Write ~generate.cards hashcards into draft/{lang}/{Topic}/ (PascalCase topics). Metadata must include lang: {code}.
4. Run: python3 scripts/validate.py
5. Do NOT push to main. Run:
   python3 scripts/draft_pr.py --message "draft({lang}/{topic}): add {n} cards ({subtopic}, {age_band})" --pr-note "Language: {lang} | Topic: {topic}"
6. Confirm an open PR exists: gh pr list --head automation/draft-cards --state open

Never edit cards/ or queue/. One language per file. Reuse the same PR branch until merged.
